<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm) are at 26.90 ppm (appearing twice, indicating two equivalent methyl carbons) and 26.18 ppm (one methyl carbon). This gives a total of three methyl (CH₃) carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
